name: retained-investigator
control: Researcher terminalizes after complete draft, fresh critic, separate fresh reviser.
treatment: Original researcher retains ONE native Goal and source context through discovery/draft, waits for independent critic, then resolves criticism and writes complete final in SAME context. Waiting/handoff costs count; no early native completion.
lineage: Declared retained context; no artificial new Goal at phase boundary
handoff_rule: Original author waits for root mechanical READY.json created only after critic native/T3 terminal completion, containing critique/source-map SHA-256. No science after terminal; no new author Goal.
adaptation_limit: Successor to source-positive A-M05-B v1; explicit terminal handoff removes unknown freeze-at-read and may reduce its observed latency saving. Not a replication of the missing receipt.
